Sporting Club Bastia is a French professional football club based in Bastia on the island of Corsica. The club plays in Ligue 3, the third tier of French football, having won the 2020–21 Championnat National. The club plays its home matches at the Stade Armand Cesari located within the city. SC Bastia is known for its strong association with Corsican nationalism.
